name: m1-23-tourism-legal-map
title: A visitor reaches Weh through five national gates — airport, port, visa, customs, cruise — and Aceh controls none of them.
sourceLine: Source: UU 11/2006 [710]; UU 37/2000 [718]; Habanusantara, Jul 2026 [717]; Dishub Aceh, SIM airport status, Apr 2024 [730]; Kompas, Nov 2025 [731]; Perpres 11/2010 [733].
